inj.note: Once the Packers officially designate Parsons for return from the PUP list, the team will have 21 days to evaluate him in practice before reinstating him to the 53-man roster. Parsons, who is working his way back from the torn ACL he sustained last December, doesn't appear to be in consideration to play this Sunday against the Patriots if he resumes practicing this week. Instead, the Packers are targeting their Nov. 25 game against the Rams in Week 12 for Parsons' debut. The star edge rusher is initially expected to be limited to individual work once the Packers open his 21-day window before potentially advancing to team drills in Week 10.

news.h: Packers expect Parsons at practice 'sometime this week'
news.d: Packers defensive end Micah Parsons will practice this week for the first time since he tore the ACL and meniscus in his left knee Dec. 14 of last year.

news.h: Sources: Packers, Micah Parsons target return for Thanksgiving Eve game vs. Rams
news.d: The Packers and Micah Parsons are targeting the Thanksgiving Eve game against the Rams for his return to the field.

news.h: Why Micah Parsons' ACL recovery is taking longer than Patrick Mahomes'
news.d: They were injured the same day, but while Mahomes was ready for Week 1, Parsons has yet to practice.

news.h: Matt LaFleur isn't ruling out imminent practice return for Micah Parsons
news.d: Green Bay Packers edge rusher Micah Parsons might finally be back on the practice field next week, more than 10 months after he underwent surgery on his left knee.
